correctness.rationale: Reversible symmetrization, strict substrate Perron monotonicity, equilibrium classification, and critical-threshold Lyapunov/LaSalle argument were checked analytically; compact diagnostics reproduce the motivating example.

originality.rationale: The inspected primary source leaves the all-rate substrate-dependent case numerical beyond its sufficient small-rate condition; synonymous/equivalent searches found no covering theorem. Residual access risks are documented in REVIEW.md.

value.rationale: The result turns an explicit numerical observation into an all-rate theorem, generalizes the cycle to reversible networks, and sharpens washout stability at the exact threshold.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
